text:
I can't name anyone, because I know of no Enron purchase of the Houston Rockets in 2000 or any other year. The premise looks mistaken.

- The Rockets were owned by Leslie Alexander, who bought the team in 1993 and still owned it at the end of the period this mail covers.
- The Houston sports deal Enron actually made was a naming-rights agreement for the Astros' ballpark, Enron Field, which opened in 2000. That was a sponsorship, not a team purchase. After Enron's collapse the name was dropped in 2002.
- I can't search or read the mailboxes from here, so I can't say whether any email discusses a Rockets deal, perhaps as a proposal or a rumor. If you want to check, the Enron Field naming-rights deal is the likely thing the question is mixing up.
